hero.title: SERVICES BUILT FOR BRANDS THAT NEED TO BE SEEN, HEARD, AND REMEMBERED.
hero.subtitle: From design and print to photography, video, audio, digital campaigns, and studio training, Tripod Creative Agency turns ideas into clear production-ready work.

intro.title: Connected services
intro.body: Twelve services are arranged as one workflow, showing how Tripod groups creative direction, capture, sound, print, and rollout support without breaking the brief into disconnected pieces.

designBrand.title: DESIGN & BRAND
designBrand.body: Identity systems, campaign design, and print-ready production surfaces.

visualProduction.title: VISUAL PRODUCTION
visualProduction.body: Photography, video, drone work, and livestream delivery handled as one capture unit.

soundStudio.title: SOUND & STUDIO
soundStudio.body: Recording, music production, podcast sessions, and practical training held in one studio environment.

digitalGrowth.title: DIGITAL GROWTH
digitalGrowth.body: Digital rollout stays tied to the campaign instead of becoming a separate afterthought.

graphicDesign.title: Graphic Design
graphicDesign.description: Campaign graphics, poster systems, and branded layouts ready for use.

branding.title: Branding
branding.description: Logo, identity, and visual direction shaped to keep the brand recognizable.

printing.title: Printing
printing.description: Printed materials prepared for events, campaigns, shops, and launches.

photography.title: Photography
photography.description: Portrait, product, and event stills captured for campaigns, content, and documentation.

videography.title: Videography
videography.description: Event coverage, commercial edits, and branded motion built for digital screens.

droneCoverage.title: Drone Coverage
droneCoverage.description: Aerial coverage that adds scale, location context, and movement.

liveStreaming.title: Live Streaming
liveStreaming.description: Multi-camera signal support for launches, events, and live moments.

audioRecording.title: Audio Recording
audioRecording.description: Voice, vocal, and studio recordings captured with clean signal and clear direction.

musicProduction.title: Music Production
musicProduction.description: Beats, arrangement, and studio shaping built around the final sound.

podcastRecording.title: Podcast Recording
podcastRecording.description: Voice-led sessions with a studio setup that keeps the conversation sharp.

digitalMarketing.title: Digital Marketing
digitalMarketing.description: Content planning and rollout support that help campaigns stay active after production.

instrumentTraining.title: Instrument Training
instrumentTraining.description: Hands-on training that builds confidence, repetition, and studio discipline.

process.title: Brief to delivery
process.body: This follows the way Tripod works in practice: clear stages, disciplined handoff, and a route from idea to delivery that stays understandable.

steps.title: Brief Lock
steps.description: We align the message, audience, deliverables, and the services needed.

steps.title: Creative Direction
steps.description: References, formats, timing, and creative direction are agreed before production starts.

steps.title: Production / Design / Record
steps.description: Design, capture, printing, or studio sessions move with one shared direction.

steps.title: Edit / Print / Package
steps.description: Assets are edited, exported, printed, or packaged for rollout.

steps.title: Launch / Deliver
steps.description: Final work is delivered ready for posting, screening, printing, or launch.

digitalSupport.title: Campaign rollout support
digitalSupport.body: If the campaign needs rollout support, content structuring, or landing-page assistance, Tripod can extend the production plan after the main brief is clear.
digitalSupport.label: DIGITAL SUPPORT

cta.title: BRING YOUR NEXT PROJECT TO TRIPOD.
cta.body: Start on WhatsApp with one service, one production zone, or a full brief and we will guide it into the right workflow.

featuredDevelopment.title: ONE BRIEF. MULTIPLE DISCIPLINES.
featuredDevelopment.description: One campaign can need design, stills, video, live coverage, audio, and rollout assets. This is where Tripod Creative Agency works as one production desk instead of fragmented suppliers.
